card.name: Small linking words in fixed phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "or", "on", "the" and "someone" in fixed, repeated phrases. The strongest case is "or" in "call a doctor or poison control center" and in contact lines giving a phone number or a website.

modes.label: Poison-control warning
modes.description: The word "or" after "call a doctor" in the accidental-overdose warning on product labels.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor<< or>> poison control center immediately.

modes.label: Contact line
modes.description: The word "or" between a phone number and a website in adverse-event reporting text.

modes.label: Manual page descriptions
modes.description: Small words inside Unix command descriptions, such as "on" and "the" in "print on the standard output".
modes.example: cat (1) - concatenate files and print<< on>> the standard output man (1) -

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are Chinese phrases and the promoted ones are mixed brand and name tokens, so there is no clear effect on the output.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words such as "or" inside stock phrases, mainly the label line "call a doctor or poison control center".
